Explicitly pinned older projects retain their release until migration. Package verification is not universal output conformance. Team account activation is separate from local installation.
Website build ui-20260929-lds095-02 restores the full 0.9.1 teaching and implementation experience with explicit 0.9.5 updates. Historical master documents and add-on bindings retain their original release identities.
